qualifications: All 38 new functions were independently rerun sequentially with tools/match.py and profile game in this successor checkpoint: 38 MATCH results, 1584 bytes. All source/catalogue bindings in the resulting certificates agree with prepare. Both prepared fresh-build receipts were read: 55 total functions / 2680 bytes including c001, identical code.bin and ExeFS .code outputs, no cached units. This reviewer did not rerun the full build or suite.

All nine new C++ units were manually checked across the current source/header declarations and independently regenerated original ABI packets. Result now has one shared definition in include/game/result.h used by both result-returning units; former F01 is resolved. Other classes, tagged handles, reserved virtual slots and destructor recovery remain partial 32-bit target descriptions. The mechanical C++ waiver still covers declarations and const analysis beyond the new token-level ODR check; these are not complete SDK type or native-port proofs.

func_00196cb8 preserves the original invalid-screen before-table path if the error handler returns; its ORIGINAL BUG comment is present. Valid index bounds and error-handler return behavior are not established. docs/known-issues-c002-wave1-r2.md now publishes this behavior, partial types and the C++ waiver, resolving former F02.

The two project headers were read and independently SHA-256 hashed against prepare.headers: bss_0049ecf0.h = e24dd2bb970c2e14e2ed2b83375ee93ad64f8cabedbecca2643bbc46f5a73fc6; result.h = d3e9723ddd7a08fa81e968adfdc0bd916bb87bef3022b78b9cd832a62fd3a461. Reviewed the new header-hash flow through review, finalize/history and verification in tools/accept.py; the new fields have explicit consuming checks. No additional gate test suite was run.

The shared CommandSystem fields were checked against both source users and regenerated original counter/queue accesses. Command kind 1 has an explicit consumer dispatch arm forwarding source and size; no silent-drop integration defect was found. The v3 catalogue was inspected directly for all 38 credited owners: all are ordinary functions, not veneers or multi_entry owners. Entry 0x12d5c4 was inspected inside its uncredited multi_entry owner; no credit is assigned to it.

Inherited in-place hybrid-build limitations remain as documented: full original-armlink layout/unwind reconstruction, runtime behavior tests, cross-host reproduction and lower RomFS IVFC traversal are separate properties not proven by these matching checks.
